summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Descartes Systems Group Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnishing its 2026 Annual General Meeting Circular (management information circular) under cover of Form 40-F. The filing provides notice of the annual meeting scheduled for June 11, 2026, with routine items: receiving financial statements, electing directors, reappointing auditors, approving a shareholder rights plan continuation, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. There is no transaction, strategic action, or special situation event—this is a routine proxy circular. Under U.S. equivalents, this would be filed as a definitive proxy statement on Schedule 14A. No deal terms, event, or catalyst warrant classification as a special situation.
